reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence medium). No API for the used-car locator itself, but Mercedes-Benz /developers offers an official VIN-based Vehicle Specification API (decode_vin) on a commercial plan.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Secret API key of a Mercedes-Benz /developers console project subscribed to Vehicle Specification (commercial plan); sent as x-api-key.

config_fields.name: locale
config_fields.help: Market locale for descriptions, e.g. de_DE or en_GB (required by the API; only some locales are supported).

adapter.terms: Mercedes-Benz /developers terms; OEM-level API that decodes any Mercedes-Benz, smart or Mercedes-Benz Vans VIN/FIN. It is the only official API behind the Mercedes-Benz used-car sites in this catalog.

decode_vin.note: GET /vehicles/{VIN or FIN}?locale&payloadNullValues=false (x-api-key): marketing specification of that exact vehicle (brand, model, longType, body, engine type, fuel, paint, options with codes, technicalData, power). modelYear is a code and stays in raw with baumuster, options and technicalData.

not_offered.search_listings: The Mercedes-Benz used-car locators have no public API; this OEM API only decodes VINs.
not_offered.get_valuation: No valuation in the Vehicle Specification API.
not_offered.list_dealers: Not part of the Vehicle Specification API.
not_offered.me: No identity endpoint for an API key.

evidence: host api.mercedes-benz.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Ireland Limited)
probe: 1/1 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 1/1 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
